actions.description: Move the hypothesis from Formulated to Testing: a real attempt to evaluate it has begun, but the falsification criteria have not yet been fully resolved either way
Real evidence directly tested the hypothesis's own falsification criteria and confirmed the hypothesis
Real evidence directly tested the hypothesis's own falsification criteria and refuted the hypothesis
Real evidence exists and points in a direction, but is too partial or weak to fully validate or invalidate yet
An external or implementation blocker prevented the falsification criteria from being tested at all -- this is not evidence against the hypothesis
Evidence is ambiguous or contradictory enough that a human should adjudicate the status change directly

Nothing has changed since the hypothesis was last assessed -- no test ran, no blocker was hit, no partial result exists. This is a no-op, distinct from a blocker or an escalation: there is genuinely nothing to report

metadata.decision_context: Given new evidence/findings bearing on an already-formulated hypothesis, decide whether its status should move to Testing, Validated, Invalidated, Inconclusive, or stay Formulated-but-blocked, be escalated to a human, or be left unchanged because nothing new occurred

complexity_profile.rationale: Mirrors SocialEngage's own classify-hypothesis-status policy (agent-learning-governance), same decision shape applied to agent-learning's own Ideation-Document.md registry.
